One of Tibia's oldest quests: cross the maze beneath Thais' {wiki:Ancient Temple|Ancient Temple} to the underground minotaur city of {wiki:Mintwallin|Mintwallin}. With the help of at least one friend you open a grate, get past a dragon and reach the treasure room with the {item:Devil Helmet}, a {item:Halberd} and 4 {item:Small Sapphire|Small Sapphires}.
Level 30 for the expertise door (40+ recommended).
**At least 2 players**: this quest cannot be done alone.
The {item:Key 3610} (obtained during the quest, see section 2).
required if you are going to get the key; useful for the poison fields
optional, for one of the exits of the quest room
Agree with the group on who will open the grate (section 4) before you start.
Bring antidotes: there are many {item:Poison Field|Poison Fields} and spiders on the way.
{creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} and {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} pulled by other players may show up.
1. Going down through the Ancient Temple maze
Go to the {wiki:Ancient Temple|Ancient Temple}, **north** of Thais. Go down **2 floors** and head as far **north** as you can.
Go down to the floor of the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}. Follow the path in the image **east** and then **south**, and go down the stairs.
Path on the Rotworm floor to the stairs

There are many {item:Poison Field|Poison Fields} on this floor. Run through them and then cure the poison with an {item:Antidote}, or use {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field} to clear a path. Then go down one more floor.
Follow the path in the image **east** and then **north**. Go down the hole marked with a circle on the map. Down there you will face some {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}.
Path to the hole (marked with a circle)
Watch out for the {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} on the way.
If you already have a {item:Key 3610}, skip this section. You need a {item:Destroy Field Rune}. This part corresponds to the {wiki:Mintwallin Cyclops Quest|Mintwallin Cyclops Quest}.
Follow the path in the image always **north** and go down one floor.
Path north to the way down

This room has many {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}, {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers} and a few {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}. Fight your way to the **south** of the room and go up one floor.
Path to the way up in the south of the room
You enter the room through the **northwest** corner (1 on the map). Follow the passage to the switch and use it. The wall moves and you are shut in with the {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}: kill them.
1: entrance; 2: exit; 3: fire where you use Destroy Field
If you can't reach the switch, it is because the wall has already been moved. You have to wait for it to reset or for someone inside to open it again.

There are some {item:Fire Field|Fire Fields} in the room. Use the {item:Destroy Field Rune} on the fire (3 on the map). Then use the hole that was uncovered and you receive the silver {item:Key 3610}.
To leave, go to the hole at the end of the passage to the **north** (2 on the map). It takes you back to the minotaur room.
Go up and come back down

Go back to the passage before the minotaur room. This time head **south** along the **leftmost** passage. Go up through the hole into a small room and go up again into another room. Go to the end of this passage and go down through the hole into a small room, and go down again.

From this passage head **south** and take the **first left**. Keep going straight, passing a path on the right (which leads to the {wiki:Mad Mage Quest|Mad Mage Quest}). Then turn **left** and keep going to the stairs down, which lead to {wiki:Mintwallin|Mintwallin}.
4. Split the group and open the grate

**At least one person** has to take this path: go down the stairs, go a little **west** and go up through a hole. Head **south** to a blocked passage and stand on the free square. This opens a grate for the others to go down.

Path of the player who opens the grate (continued)
Path of the player who opens the grate (to the free square)
Rest of the group: going down through the grate

The rest of the group takes the other passage **south** until they find {creature:Spider|spiders} and {item:Poison Field|Poison Fields}. The grate should already be open: all of you go down through it.
Pass the **level 30** quest door and go up the next hole. On this floor there is a {creature:Dragon} guarding the last room: kill it.
The holes in the floor lead to a {creature:Giant Spider} waiting for you down below, and you cannot climb back up that way. Don't fall into them!
Opening the door with the key

Go to the door and use the {item:Key 3610}. Take the last step and go down. Down there you will face 3 {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards}, 2 {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers} and {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}.
Map of the path to the quest room
Map of the path to the quest room (continued)
In the quest room, collect the {item:Devil Helmet}, the {item:Halberd} and the 4 {item:Small Sapphire|Small Sapphires}.
You have three options to leave:
Go back the way you came in.

Open the quest room door with the {item:Key 3610}, kill the {creature:Giant Spider} (or run from it) and fall into the hole at the end of the passage. You land in a room with 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, which leads back to the maze under the Ancient Temple.

In the quest room, go **west** through a small passage. At the end, use a {item:Pick} to open a hole in the floor and fall. You end up in a small passage inside Mintwallin castle and come out in {npc:Markwin}'s throne room.

Whichever exit you take, you end up in the maze under the {wiki:Ancient Temple|Ancient Temple}: follow the path from section 1 in reverse, going up the same stairs and holes (use the {item:Rope} on the holes) to the temple, **north** of Thais.
- **Option 2:** the room with the 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} is a shortcut back to the maze. Note: the hole you fell through is one-way (you can't climb up with a rope), so you can't go back that way to Mintwallin.
- **Option 3:** leave {npc:Markwin}'s castle to Mintwallin's main gate; next to it, a few steps **east**, go up one of the two stairs and keep going through the maze to the Ancient Temple.
Beware of the one-way holes: there are several in this maze and you cannot climb back up through them.
